name: FNAF: Pizza Party
desc:
⭐ Medic role added! Includes all new features.
⚙️ Bug fixes & Improvements!

Welcome to Pizza Party! This is a FNaF inspired ROBLOX games that conveniently mixes elements from both puzzle & collector games to provide you the ultimate puzzle piece horror game. Currently in it's first chapter, there are 5 parts. There will be more chapters added and game modes to choose from. Five Nights at Freddy's.
